title: Wellsfargo supports  APIASF
description: Interact with Philippine News  Website http://www.philippinenews.com  Facebook http://www.facebook.com/pages/Philippine-News/175806217958  Youtube http://www.youtube.com/user/PhilippineNews1  Twittter http://www.twitter.com/philippinenews1  Livestream http://www.livestream.com/philippinenews?t=861748  Truth Esguerra's Twitter http://www.twitter.com/truthesguerra

asr.full_text: Yo, what's up guys? This is AJ Rafael and you're watching PhilippineNews.com. Yeah, WorldSong has always been a big sponsor to the Asian community. Particularly today, we are really excited to be a sponsor of the Asia-Pacific Fund. It's really putting a lot of needy Asian-American students into college, and then for themselves to be financially independent, as well as for the families as well. We believe in the community that we serve, if the community strives, that means we will do well as well. We always do a lot of different support for the financial literacy, including we reach out to schools to do financial education, to teach students how to save, how to open their first checking account, how to even balance a checkbook and so forth. There are a lot of resources out there both financially as well as you know companies like Wells Fargo, we always here to reach out to the community to educate. So get, get out and get the, get into the network of different nonprofits to support you.
